title: Goa geography
text: Goa is a state on the southwestern coast of India. It borders the Arabian Sea and is known for its beaches, estuaries, and Western Ghats forests.

title: Goa history
text: Goa was a Portuguese colony until it was annexed by India in 1961. The state has a layered history reflected in its architecture, cuisine, and languages.

title: Goa capital
text: Panaji, also called Panjim, is the capital city of Goa. It sits on the banks of the Mandovi River and is an important administrative and cultural centre.

title: Goa climate
text: Goa has a tropical monsoon climate. The southwest monsoon generally brings heavy rainfall between June and September, while the winter months are comparatively dry.

title: Goa wildlife
text: The Western Ghats in Goa support biodiversity including evergreen forests, birds, reptiles, and mammals. Protected areas help conserve these ecosystems.

title: Retrieval augmented generation
text: Retrieval-augmented generation combines information retrieval with language generation. A retriever selects relevant evidence, and a generator writes an answer grounded in that evidence.

title: Grounded answers
text: A grounded RAG system should cite retrieved passages and abstain when the evidence is insufficient. Retrieval scores, citation checks, and answer-context overlap are useful safeguards.

title: Speech recognition
text: Speech-to-text converts a spoken audio signal into text. Sarvam Saaras is designed for speech recognition across Indian languages and English, including multilingual use cases.
